chars.BOY: a skinny 13-year-old Moroccan boy with messy black curly hair, wearing an oversized bright red basketball jersey with the number 10 and grey shorts
chars.HUSBAND: a stocky Moroccan man in his thirties with a short black beard, wearing a white sleeveless undershirt and blue striped pajama trousers
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman wearing a long modest pink satin robe and a white headscarf loosely over her hair
chars.GUY: a tall young Moroccan man with a fade haircut and thin moustache, wearing a black tracksuit with white stripes on the sleeves

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small hot bedroom in a working-class flat in Beni Mellal, 2010. BOY sits at an old desktop computer with a bulky CRT monitor, caught mid-moment, head-to-waist framing seen from the bedroom doorway, face visible and lit by the screen glow, biting his nails with a guilty, troubled expression. A small fan on the desk. No text anywhere, screen shows only a blurry blue glow.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same small bedroom at night. BOY stands up from the computer chair, both hands on his head, eyes wide, determined and nervous as if he just made a big decision. Head-to-waist framing, face visible. Warm lamp light. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Living room of a modest Moroccan flat at night. BOY crouches next to a cheap home inkjet printer on a low table as it pushes out pages; he holds up a page and squints at it with a comic disappointed face because the printed photos are only grey black-and-white blurry shapes. Moroccan salon cushions in the background. Pages show only blurry grey shapes, no readable text or letters.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, the narrow stairwell landing of an old apartment building in a popular Moroccan neighbourhood. BOY, on tiptoe, sneakily slides a big thick brown envelope into a metal mailbox on the wall, looking over his shoulder, face visible, mischievous and scared. Dim yellow bulb. No writing on the envelope or mailbox.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Late night, BOY in his bed in a dark small bedroom, sitting up suddenly with the blanket pulled to his chin, eyes wide with shock, ear turned toward the open window where orange street light comes in, as if hearing loud shouting outside. Face visible. No text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night in a narrow street (derb) of a working-class Moroccan neighbourhood, old apartment buildings, street lamp, hot summer night. HUSBAND storms down the middle of the street shouting furiously, pointing ahead, veins on his neck; WIFE hurries behind him trying to grab his arm, crying and begging. Neighbours peek from windows in the background. Main action in the centre. No text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night in the same narrow Moroccan derb under a street lamp. HUSBAND and GUY face each other in a heated confrontation in front of a building doorway, shouting; two neighbour men in djellabas hold them apart by the arms. Tense, dramatic, crowd of neighbours watching in the background. No weapons visible, no blood. Main subjects in the centre. No text.
